en: A vintage postcard featuring an illustrated view of a large mosque with two tall minarets, bustling waterfront activity with boats, and people gathered at the shore. The architecture is distinctly Ottoman, and the postcard uses pastel colors. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Constantinople and the mosque as 'Mosquée de la Sultane Validé.' There is also handwritten correspondence at the bottom.
